page_annotations: Apart from r001 and the folio number, the page is blank on image review. Faint mirrored writing is show-through and is not transcribed.
Ink specks and smudges at the upper left and middle (around 585,770; 330,1080; 370,1290; 1815,1600; 2380,4360) are not text.
Fragments beyond the gutter (x > ~3200) belong to fol. 70 and are not target records. They include 'd. 6…', 'e. …', 'm/', 'ā/', '✓ d…', 'cat s. Bhā…', 's/' and 'ś/?'.
unresolved_relationships: The exact target holding or shelfmark of the 'ff. 1-4' addendum on fol. 70 is not explicit.

coverage.finding: An ink '69' with a raised 'b' stands at the top left, about [385,320,135,145]. r002 records it correctly as the visible folio number. The supplied folio label 'fol. 69b' agrees with it.

A single ink line runs at about y≈2030–2110, from x≈515 to x≈2110. It reads 'adhy. 34 Śamkhacūḍāvadha, adhy. 35 Gopīkānug?ta. ff. 1-4.' It has no shelfmark and no heading. The text is complete. The only problem is the vowel of 'gita' in 'Gopīkānugita'. As written it looks short or undotted, so the candidate's long 'ī' there is over-certain. A change is proposed below.

A small ink cross- or arrow-like mark lies at about [3014,2045,80,30], level with b002 and just left of the gutter. A '+'-like mark appears in the left margin of fol. 70 at the same height, beside '✓ d. 311 (2) Gopīgītā'. Treating it as a reference sign is reasonable, but the link is only probable.

changes.reason: In the native tile the vowel after 'g' in the final word shows no clear macron, and the candidate's own uncertainty note says the vowel looks short. The literal text should not assert a long ī there. The mark over the i after 'p' looks like a caret or macron, so 'Gopī' is kept.

unresolved.issue: Attachment to the fol. 70 Gopīgītā entry rests only on matching reference marks at the same height. It is not stated in words. It is also unclear which of d. 311 (2), d. 313 or d. 1070 (9) the extent 'ff. 1-4.' belongs to.
unresolved.next_check: Compare the native-resolution fol. 70 left-margin mark and the d. 311 (2) line with the b901 mark.

unresolved.issue: Several diacritics are uncertain. It is not clear whether an anusvāra dot stands over the m of 'Śamkha', whether the i of 'gita' is long or short, or whether the i of 'Gopī' carries a macron or a caret. The second digit of '34' is cursive.
unresolved.next_check: Examine the native pixels at about x 760–1200 and 1480–1880, y 2000–2120.

unresolved.issue: Neither the inventory nor the candidate lists a curved, dotted, grey smudge at about [1960,1700,90,190] in the middle of the page. It appears to be offset or smudge and is not text, so no record is required.
unresolved.next_check: Confirm under magnification that it holds no writing.

review.boundary_review: The target page ends at the gutter, at about x≈3150–3200, where a sewing hole is visible near y≈1500. Writing beyond it belongs to fol. 70 and is not a target record. This includes 'd. 6…', 'e. …', 'd', 'e', 'E', 'm/', 'ā/', '✓ d…', 'cat s. Bhā…', 's/' and 'ś/?'. It also includes a faint pencil curved bracket line at x≈3470–3500, y≈3330–4000, which is fol. 70's brace for d. 653 (9) and e. 121 (5). The candidate's page annotations omit that bracket, but it is a facing-page feature only. The link from b002 to fol. 70 remains probable and is not resolved.

region_review.bottom: Ruled lines carry show-through only. There is an isolated dot at about (2367,4366) and nothing else written.
region_review.left_margin: Specks near the binding edge at about (330,1080), and faint dotted diagonal strokes at about (400–600, 1300–1560). Neither is text.
region_review.right_margin: Holds the b901 mark at about (3014,2045). Beyond it lie the gutter and fragments of the facing fol. 70.
